spec.training: 50% clean, 50% state-conditioned gaps and slot defects; team symmetry
spec.weighting: Equal provider, match, view and team-swap mass
spec.D: Unchanged pooled GRU/HGB probabilities shared by every team arm
spec.ranking: Provider/seed mean official spell F1, exact ties macro F1
spec.auxiliary: 0.7 spell + 0.3 macro, never used for competition ranking
spec.scope: Reused pooled external development; NOT unseen-provider transfer or fresh confirmation
spec.organizer: Tracking-only first-half calibration; no possession labels or public scoring
spec.uncertainty: Three evaluation-view seeds; one frozen training draw, not training-seed uncertainty
